chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 435: Ji Ning Buys Five Elements Treasures & Meets the Seamless Gate
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning attempts to buy rare treasures for the Starseizing Hand. The Xia Emperor helps, but the cost is high. Meanwhile, the panicking Shaoyin clan is contacted by the mysterious Seamless Gate.
og_title: The Cost of Godly Power in Desolate Era
og_description: Ji Ning goes shopping for Five Elements treasures while the Shaoyin clan gets a terrifying offer from the Seamless Gate.
twitter_title: Ji Ning's treasure hunt meets a Seamless Gate crisis!
twitter_description: The calm before the storm: Ji Ning gathers resources while his enemies seek a dangerous alliance.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare celestial metal used in crafting high-tier magic treasures, often associated with the Metal element.
A treasure of immense power, comparable to a mid-grade Innate spirit-treasure. It is a standard high-end asset for Pure Yang True Immortals and Heavenly Gods.
A mysterious and incredibly powerful organization from outside the Three Realms, operating as a shadowy force that rivals the established powers like the Grand Xia.
An immortal being who has transcended the mortal coil by surviving the Heavenly Tribulation, gaining limitless lifespan.

surfaces: Six Cycles of the Starseizing Hand
lore_anchors.definition: A legendary divine ability created by Daofather Threelives, ranked among the top ten in the Three Realms. It trains the hands to become as powerful as magic treasures.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Ji Ning need so many Five Elements treasures?
cultural_notes_faq.a: To train the 'Starseizing Hand' divine ability, which requires massive amounts of rare elemental materials to strengthen his hands to the level of magic treasures.
He is the Xia Emperor's spirit-beast (灵兽) and a trusted confidant who manages affairs in the imperial city on the Emperor's behalf.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is the Shaoyin clan so afraid of Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They fear his incredible potential for growth. If he is already this strong, they dread how powerful he will become in the future and when he will choose to take his revenge.
